answer: Prayers & Duties >> Hajj & Umrah Question ID: 5803 Country: United Kingdom Title: If one is in the state of Ihraam, can one touch the Ka'bah or go to the Multazam as it is fragranced? Question: If one is in the state of Ihraam, can one touch the Ka'bah or go to the Multazam as it is fragranced? Answer ID: 5803 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 476/476=M/1429) In the state of Ihraam, it is prohibited to touch Ka?ba and Multazam when they are soaked in perfume and attar. One should avoid touching his body. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
